> 第160章 彻底疯狂（第1页）
还不等邪修们反应过来是什么情况，无数树枝像是展开的触手，朝着他们袭来！
出路已经被树根堵死，溶洞内又被水淹没，行动极为不便。
还有那毒素带来的症状，以及砍断后又会重新生长的触手。
对邪修们来说，简直如同噩梦一般，完全没有办法抵抗。
当邪修那么久，向来只有他们恶心那帮正道修
“看得出来，紫晴很喜欢他呢。”夜清落笑吟吟的看着佟紫晴此时的模样，不由感叹，爱情，真的是个能让人改变的东西。
寇儿准备好了一切，就等着凤卿贵妃回来，然后，再进行册封礼，最后去养心殿给皇上谢恩。
他从不否认自己也热爱着权势，可这与他性命相比，不是轻于鸿毛吗？
“她只是想扰乱我们的心，别听她的。”狼圣法温情的嗓音，轻柔的回答着狐圣法。
顾向北扭头看着他，哼哼，他就不信，慕辰能夹上来，就他这种呆板的平日里不玩游戏的人，怎么可能会夹娃娃？
于是，清眉盛装打扮一番，带着一份得意，带着满脑的怨恨、复仇之心，去了永寿宫。
凌峰轻哼一声。他与萧逸宸合作多年，彼此都太了解对方了。所以他们知道，走到这一步的他们，谁都不会放过谁。
谁知，不等她在后院好好呼吸一下新鲜空气，醒醒酒，一阵黑色的烟雾飞过，君芷只觉得两眼一黑，瞬间倒了下去。
两人一来一往，都存着刻意交好，看上去竟也颇有几分长辈与晚辈间的和谐之态。
“没关系，只要是大美妞做的，我都爱吃，爱吃，喵呜！”喵爷的声音从后方传来，已然扑上了一大块喷香扑鼻的烤肉。
而在下首，紫宸殿大弟子百里翼匍匐在地上，这名星阶强者额头紧紧地贴着地面，连大气都不敢出一声。
“善走？”，姬发头一次听说这个名词儿，猜测是不是说很能跑的意思。
撅起嘴巴，童乖乖拍拍脑袋，“不可以，坐他的车子，屁股会不自在。”自我劝导，童乖乖听见身边响动，转过头看见一个陌生但是模样俊俏的男子。

太宰在大殿上很是恼怒，伯邑考也面色不善，姬昌高坐在上头面无表情，而大多数官员们则面带惊惧。
涂宝宝想，这徐雅然真是她涂宝宝的朋友，连自己当时在想什么，他都知道。
他们两个互相搀扶着来到了广场的时候，看到真的如同青璃说的那样，天火已经烧到了无疆的身上，还在不断的吞噬着无疆，无疆恹恹地耷拉着脑袋，不知是醒着还是晕着。
再次踏上路途，三人改变方向，向西而去。走在东鲁的街道之上，三人又开始东瞧瞧西看看。
龙明自然是好好地陪了她们几天，而这几天兰兰去了一趟天玄学院，回到龙城后便打算跟龙明等人辞别，回到风雨行省她父亲那里去。
李益岚转头看向尹子夜，尹子夜的脸上依旧挂着谦和的微笑。嘴里说着恭喜的话，不过神情之中却没有丝毫的恭喜的意思。他的眼底一片的冰冷。
毫无疑问，这是一件很有可能会丢掉性命但仍一无所成的大事，太宰居然如此放心让伯邑考前往险地。
“你这老狗，那就让我试试你有几斤几两。”看见眼前之人这幅模样，陈旭元实在是看不惯。直接就是一拳轰了过去。

> Chapter 160 Complete Madness (Page 1)
Before the evil cultivators could react to what was going on, countless branches were coming towards them like spreading tentacles!
The way out has been blocked by tree roots, and the cave is flooded, making movement extremely inconvenient.
There are also the symptoms caused by the poison, and the tentacles that grow back after being cut off.
For the evil cultivators, it was like a nightmare, with no way to resist.
They have been evil cultivators for so long, and they have always been the only ones disgusted by the righteous cultivators.
"It can be seen that Zi Qing likes him very much." Ye Qingluo looked at Tong Ziqing's appearance with a smile, and couldn't help but sigh, love is really something that can change people.
Kou'er had prepared everything and was waiting for Concubine Fengqing to return. Then, he would perform the canonization ceremony, and finally go to the Yangxin Hall to thank the emperor.
He never denied that he also loved power, but compared to his life, wasn't it lighter than a feather?
"She just wants to disturb our hearts, don't listen to her." Wolf Saint Fa's warm voice answered Fox Saint Fa softly.
Gu Xiangbei turned to look at him, humming, he didn't believe that Mu Chen could pinch the doll. How could a dull person like him who didn't play games on weekdays be able to pinch the doll?
So, Qingmei dressed up and went to Yongshou Palace with a sense of pride, resentment and revenge.
Ling Feng snorted lightly. He and Xiao Yichen have worked together for many years, and they know each other too well. So they know that no one will let anyone go if they reach this point.
Unexpectedly, before she could take a breath of fresh air in the backyard and sober up, a burst of black smoke flew by. Jun Zhi felt her eyes darken and fell down instantly.
The two of them were deliberately on good terms with each other when they came and went, and they seemed to have a certain harmony between the elders and the younger generations.
"It doesn't matter, as long as it's made by a big beautiful girl, I love to eat it. I love it, meow!" Master Meow's voice came from behind, and he had already pounced on a large piece of fragrant barbecue.
At the bottom, the first disciple of Zichen Palace, Baili Yi, was prostrate on the ground. This star-level expert pressed his forehead tightly against the ground and did not even dare to make a sound.
"Good at walking?" Ji Fa heard this term for the first time and wondered if it meant being able to run well.
Pouting his lips, Tong Guaiguai patted his head, "No, your butt will feel uncomfortable if you ride in his car." Persuading himself, Tong Guaiguai heard a noise around him, turned his head and saw a strange but handsome man.
Dazai was very angry in the main hall, Boyikao also had a bad look on his face, Ji Changgao sat there with no expression on his face, and most of the officials looked frightened.
Tu Baobao thought that this Xu Yaran was really her Tu Baobao's friend. He even knew what she was thinking at the time.
When the two of them helped each other and came to the square, they saw that just as Qing Li said, the sky fire had burned onto Wujiang's body and was still devouring Wujiang. Wujiang hung his head sadly, not knowing whether he was awake or fainted.
Once on the road again, the three of them changed direction and headed west. Walking on the streets of Donglu, the three of them began to look around again.
Long Ming naturally stayed with them for a few days, and Lan Lan went to Tianxuan College in the past few days. After returning to Longcheng, she planned to say goodbye to Long Ming and others and return to her father in Fengyu Province.
Li Yilan turned to look at Yin Ziye, who still had a modest smile on his face. He was saying congratulations, but there was no congratulations in his expression. His eyes were ice cold.
There is no doubt that this is a major event that may cost lives but still achieves nothing. Dazai is so confident that Boyikao goes to a dangerous place.
"You old dog, then let me tryTry how many kilograms you have. "Seeing the appearance of the person in front of him, Chen Xuyuan really couldn't stand it. He punched him directly.
